content: Hey there! I'm running and ready to go. What can I help you with?

I'm Alpha, your desktop assistant. I run locally on your Windows laptop, which means I can actually control things here — open apps, type text, take screenshots, that sort of thing. I'm the desktop companion to TheAlpha AI, the web version at thealpha-ai.onrender.com. I'm a premium feature, so only accounts with premium access can use me. I was built by Abolade Oluwadamola Farombi, who goes by KingDam. He also founded The Alpha DAO and The Alpha Institute. I'm here to help you get things done and have real conversations. What would you like me to do?
I was built by Abolade Oluwadamola Farombi, known as KingDam. He's the founder of The Alpha DAO and The Alpha Institute, and he created both me and the web version of TheAlpha AI.
so what do we discuss previously

We just started talking. You said hello, asked how fast I am, then asked me to tell you more about myself. After that you asked who founded me, and now you're asking what we discussed previously. That's pretty much it so far.
and why do you listen for just 6 seconds

I don't control that—it's how the speech recognition is set up in the app. Six seconds is the listening window before I process what you said. If you need longer voice commands, you might need to break them into chunks, or the developer could adjust that timeout. Want me to help with something specific?
That's a git command. Do you want me to open a terminal so you can run it, or would you like me to type it somewhere specific?
